verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships llmster, a headless daemon explicitly designed for servers, cloud instances, and CI, plus a local REST/OpenAI-compatible server that can be exposed beyond localhost, which together enable genuine self-hosting of inference. However, community evidence confirms the core app and even the newer Bionic app are closed-source with license terms hostile to commercial/work use, undermining full 'openness' self-hosting (e.g., no ability to audit/build from source or self-host without accepting restrictive licensing). Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core binary/daemon, license terms permitting unrestricted commercial self-hosting, and clearer first-party guidance for pure daemon-only deployment (a user notes wishing for a true daemon mode without the Electron UI).
